question: Which sports analytics strategy should we pursue?

decision_analysis.rationale: Category leadership provides the strongest competitive advantage in sports analytics

strategic_options.title: Category Leadership Strategy
strategic_options.description: Concentrate resources to become the dominant category leader in sports analytics through aggressive investment and accelerated execution.
strategic_options.strategic_objective: Win category leadership through concentrated focus and accelerated growth investment

strategic_options.title: Diversified Portfolio Strategy
strategic_options.description: Spread investment across multiple sports categories to reduce concentration risk and capture broad market exposure.
strategic_options.strategic_objective: Portfolio diversification across sports verticals for risk-adjusted returns

strategic_options.title: Wait and Monitor Strategy
strategic_options.description: Monitor market conditions before committing to a strategic direction, preserving optionality.
strategic_options.strategic_objective: Preserve strategic optionality through staged commitment and market monitoring

assumptions.text: Category concentration in sports analytics delivers superior risk-adjusted returns compared to diversification
Sports data infrastructure can be built at scale within the available capital budget
Category leadership is achievable within a 3-year investment horizon given current market fragmentation

risks.text: Category concentration risk if the primary sports analytics vertical declines unexpectedly
risks.statement: Concentration in one category creates vulnerability to sector downturns
risks.mitigation: Maintain option value in secondary categories

risks.text: Execution complexity in scaling sports analytics operations across markets
risks.statement: Operational scaling requires significant talent and infrastructure investment

recommendations.text: Prioritize category leadership initiatives in sports analytics with concentrated investment

opportunities.text: Growing sports analytics market with limited category leaders presents first-mover advantage
opportunities.statement: Category leadership opportunity in fragmented sports analytics market

strategic_synthesis: The analysis supports a category leadership approach in sports analytics, with strong evidence for concentrated investment and accelerated execution.

confidence_drivers: Strong market data supports category thesis
Proven execution model in adjacent markets
